title: One product. More than one atom history.
source_citation: González Pérez et al. · J. Org. Chem. 2009, 74, 2982–2991
scope: Atom-by-atom replay of captured growth events in one actual cut context. The common prefix and oxygen split are recorded transitions. One other subtree with two terminal branches is shown as an ellipsis. Two full witnesses are featured; all four terminals remain in the inspectable trace.
